queries: WITH acct AS (SELECT t.account_id, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amt FROM trans t GROUP BY t.account_id), reg AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(a.avg_amt) AS region_figure FROM acct a JOIN account ac ON ac.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = ac.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), overall AS (SELECT AVG(region_figure) AS overall_avg FROM reg) SELECT r.region, r.region_figure, r.region_figure - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_avg, r.region_figure / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_avg FROM reg r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE r.region_figure > o.overall_avg

WITH acc AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS acc_avg FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3), reg AS (SELECT region, AVG(acc_avg) AS region_avg FROM acc GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(region_avg) AS all_avg FROM reg) SELECT r.region, r.region_avg, r.region_avg - o.all_avg AS excess_over_avg, r.region_avg / o.all_avg AS ratio_to_avg FROM reg r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE r.region_avg > o.all_avg

assumptions.assumption: Amounts are averaged as stored (unsigned), with no sign adjustment by trans.type, since the request says to average trans.amount.
The all-region average is the unweighted mean of the regional figures, not the mean across accounts. This follows the request's wording ('average across all regions').
Accounts with no transactions are excluded, because they have no average to compute.

assumptions.assumption: trans.amount is averaged as stored (unsigned), with no sign adjustment for credit/withdrawal type, and all transaction types (PRIJEM, VYDAJ, VYBER) are included.
The 'average across all regions' is the unweighted mean of the regional figures (each region counts equally), which is also the denominator for the ratio.
Accounts with no transactions are excluded, since they have no average to compute.

assumptions.assumption: trans.amount is averaged as stored (unsigned), without applying a sign for credit/debit direction.
The 'average across all regions' is the unweighted mean of the regional figures (the same average used as the divisor in the ratio), not an average over accounts or transactions.
Accounts with no transactions have no per-account average and are excluded.
